**4B.5 Research Note**
Bottom line: strongly negative. I found no credible 2024 evidence that Erdoğan avoided personality-cult politics, loyalty tests, party capture, or politicization of supposedly neutral state institutions. The strongest material points the other way: executive dominance over the legislature, biased state media, politicized courts, and retaliation against opposition local officials.

| Polarity | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | IDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Negative | [Turkey: Freedom in the World 2024 Country Report](https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024) | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/turkey/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says Erdoğan controls executive functions, effectively controls the legislature through the AKP, and intervenes against ministries and independent public bodies that resist him. That is direct evidence of politicizing neutral institutions rather than keeping them insulated. | 4B.5; 4B.4; 4B.2 |
| Negative | [World Report 2024: Türkiye](https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey) | Human Rights Watch | 2024 | https://www.hrw.org/world-report/2024/country-chapters/turkey | HRW says the election campaign gave the ruling coalition an unjustified advantage, with TRT favoring ruling parties and RTÜK issuing arbitrary fines to critical channels. This is evidence of state-media capture and politicization of regulatory bodies. | 4B.5; 4B.2; 4B.3 |
| Negative | [Kurdish Politicians Convicted in Unjust Mass Trial](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/16/turkiye-kurdish-politicians-convicted-unjust-mass-trial) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-05-16 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/05/16/turkiye-kurdish-politicians-convicted-unjust-mass-trial | HRW says 24 Kurdish politicians were convicted in a manifestly political trial and that the court ignored European Court of Human Rights rulings. This is strong evidence of judicial politicization and punishment of disfavored political actors. | 4B.5; 4B.4; 4B.2 |
| Negative | [Türkiye: Stonewalling on Charges for Officials in Earthquake Deaths](https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/27/turkiye-stonewalling-charges-officials-earthquake-deaths) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-03-27 | https://www.hrw.org/news/2024/03/27/turkiye-stonewalling-charges-officials-earthquake-deaths | HRW says weak judicial scrutiny and administrative permission rules block meaningful accountability for officials tied to earthquake deaths. That points to politicized protection of officials rather than neutral oversight. | 4B.5; 4B.4 |
| Negative | [Turkey removes two more pro-Kurdish mayors from office for links to banned group](https://apnews.com/article/3c6c33fd7fa2d86c9dc34089e6a98c9b) | Associated Press | 2024-11-22 | https://apnews.com/article/3c6c33fd7fa2d86c9dc34089e6a98c9b | AP reports elected mayors were removed and replaced with state appointees after opposition victories, with critics calling the moves politically motivated. This is direct evidence of using state power to neutralize opposition officeholders. | 4B.5; 4B.4; 4B.1 |
| Negative | [Turkey](https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/turkey) | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/turkey | The report says Erdoğan entered the term with continued tight media control and that the campaign environment remained structurally favorable to incumbency. That is consistent with a captured information environment, not neutral state administration. | 4B.5; 4B.2; 4B.3 |

**Search gap**
I did not find reliable 2024 evidence showing Erdoğan deliberately avoided personality cult behavior or actively depoliticized state institutions that normally should remain neutral. I also did not find a meaningful positive example of party capture being reversed. The narrow exception is that some institutions still produced adverse rulings or elections, but those did not amount to a broader anti-capture pattern.
